name: Aimai na Ore to Kachiki na Imouto no Kankei
original_name: 愛妹な俺と勝気な妹の関係
source:
My little sister Saya would hide in my room and masturbate -- and I kept feigning ignorance. One night, while the two of us were alone in the house, I heard my sister say sadly, "Big Brother..." When I heard my little sister, who was usually so strong-willed, say those words, I opened a door I never should have... Am I going to love my little sister, or break her?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ031686.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我的妹妹沙耶会躲在我的房间里自慰——而我一直假装不知道。一天晚上，家里只有我们两个人，我听到妹妹伤心地说：“哥哥……”当我听到平时意志坚强的妹妹说出这句话时，我打开了一扇不该打开的门……我是要爱我的妹妹，还是要毁掉她？

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ031686.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
